command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$projects='CampusNetwork_02','CampusNetwork_03','CampusNetwork_04','CampusNetwork_05','CampusNetwork_06','CampusNetwork_07','CampusNetwork_08','CampusNetwork_09'; `$nodes='PE1','PE2','PE3','Core_SW_01','Core_SW_02','AGG_SW_01','AGG_SW_02'; `$enc=[uri]::EscapeDataString('display current-configuration'); foreach(`$p in `$projects){foreach(`$n in `$nodes){try{`$o=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ('http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/'+`$p+'/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd='+`$enc)).output; if(`$o -notlike 'Error:*'){`$m=`$o -split '\r?\n' | Where-Object {`$_ -match 'bpdu-filter|ospf cost|isis cost|stp instance [0-9]+ cost|route-static 150|route-static 160'}; if(`$m){Write-Output ('### '+`$p+' '+`$n); `$m}}}catch{}}}"
